propositions: Deterministic mutant corpus, thresholds, and counting helpers built as WIP on branch calib/6982-e2 with golden tests, but intentionally not landed on main because the harness only drives the rejected LLM batch.

~100-run live LLM batch baseline (e2_baseline.json, e2_run_validity.json, e2_verdicts.jsonl) permanently rejected on cost and superseded by story d8a5 (change #798 on main) standing criterion_effectiveness.py recorder which accumulates detection/FP signal at $0 marginal LLM cost.

Five defect classes seeded mechanically into real cleanly-closed plans (absent asserted capability, layer-cake split, consumed-artifact-without-ordering-edge, unnecessary mechanism, untagged operational AC) to construct ground-truth labels without circular LLM re-adjudication.
Store-clone isolation implemented by construction (standalone git clone with own .git directory) prevents mutation commits from contaminating real .tickets-tracker.
Counting helpers (classify_pair, run_validity) enforce ≥0.20 INDETERMINATE run-validity cap and handle gate PASS/BLOCK/INDETERMINATE verdicts with multi-criteria set-intersection attribution.
History-based baseline mining is dead due to impact_model_version bump stranding ~4 plan-v3 baselines when ~200 are needed.
